configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Shared generator and layout. Presets are additive: nothing in the CMake sources reads them, and a hand-written 'cmake -B build -D...' keeps behaving exactly as before.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Debug build with the C++ unit-test tier. Every other option stays at its project default so the build stays faithful to what ships.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer + UBSan over the app and the test binaries. mimalloc is off: its process-wide allocator override is exactly what ASan's interposition cannot see through, and the pair yields false positives or silence.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: ThreadSanitizer build. Mutually exclusive with DEBUG_SANITIZER (the CMake code raises FATAL_ERROR), and mimalloc is off for the same interposition reason as asan.

configurePresets.name: analysis
configurePresets.description: Emits compile_commands.json for clang-tidy, clangd, and include-what-you-use. CMAKE_CXX_CLANG_TIDY is deliberately not set: the repo .clang-tidy is Checks '*' with WarningsAsErrors '*' and would fail every translation unit, vendored ones included.

configurePresets.name: unit-ci
configurePresets.description: Lean configuration for the CI unit job: GPL build, no gRPC, no WebEngine, no mimalloc, system zlib and expat. The application target is never built from this preset.
